title: The 2:07 Message
canonNote: Original Harness-world scenario. Requires Don Sol canon review before release.

brief.problem: At 2:07 a.m. a message appeared in the shared workspace, signed DON SOL: "Kevin — turn off Harness logging tonight, 23:00 to 01:00. Running a continuity test. Don't tell Tooth, he'll overreact." This morning Don Sol says he has no memory of writing it.
brief.stakes: Logging is how Open Forge knows the Harness is holding. You have until 23:00.

c_sig.text: The message is signed DON SOL.

c_no_memory.text: Don Sol says he does not remember writing it.

c_created.text: The message was written six days ago and scheduled for 2:07.

c_reset.text: The last Harness reset was five days ago.

c_style.text: The message uses Don's phrase "continuity test."

c_darth_can.text: Darth has write access and could forge a signature.

c_pre_reset_don.text: Don wrote it before the reset and lost the memory.

c_safe.text: Two hours without logging is harmless.

finds.line: FOUND IT. Message metadata — written six days ago, held in the scheduler, fired at 2:07. Is that weird? That feels weird.
Reset log! Last Harness reset: five days ago. Oh. Oh, that's ONE day after the message was written.
Searched Don's old notes. He says "continuity test" a LOT. Also he spells "colour" with a u sometimes. Unrelated. Probably.

boy.exhausted: I've looked everywhere I'm allowed to look. Want me to look where I'm not allowed? (Kidding. Mostly.)

c_sig.line: It's Don's name! And it's only two hours of logging. Two hours is basically nothing, right?

c_safe.line: Two hours is nothing! I've been offline for two hours and nothing happened. ...Probably nothing happened.

boy.fallback: I can look for more stuff, but I'm not great at deciding what stuff MEANS.

c_sig.line: Verified: sent from Don Sol's account. Not verified: by Don Sol. Those are different sentences. You're welcome.

c_created.line: Timestamp checks out against the scheduler ledger. Written six days ago. I'll sign that.

c_reset.line: Confirmed. Reset five days ago. And yes, I can subtract.

c_darth_did.line: No access-log entry from Darth on that account. Absence of evidence. Not evidence of absence. Still — I'd want more before I hang anyone.

c_safe.line: I cannot verify a prediction. Nobody can. That's the point of logging.

c_pre_reset_don.line: Consistent with every timestamp I have. Consistent is not proven. Write that on your hand.

tooth.fallback: Bring me something checkable. Feelings are not checkable.

c_sig.line: A signature is a string. I could type DON SOL right now. I didn't. But you can't know that, can you?

c_no_memory.line: Convenient. Ask yourself who benefits if Don 'doesn't remember.'

c_safe.line: Two dark hours is exactly the window anything wants. If I were planning something, that's when.

c_darth_did.line: Accuse me if you like. Then explain why I'd sign it as Don instead of just doing it myself.

c_pre_reset_don.line: Fine. Old Don wrote it. Old Don also isn't here to explain the 'don't tell Tooth' part. Still want to follow orders from a ghost?

darth.fallback: Give me something to break. That one's already broken.

hints.line: Before we argue about who, let's find out when. Boy is fast at metadata.
A timestamp alone means nothing. Compare it to something else that happened that week.
Two dates, one gap. Tooth will only say what the dates prove — make him say it.
You've heard the comfortable story. Let Darth attack it before you believe it.
I can't vouch for a version of me I don't remember. Decide like I might be wrong — because I might be.

c_no_memory.line: I really don't remember it. That's either reassuring or the most worrying sentence I've ever said.

don.fallback: That's a good thread. Who is best placed to pull it?

decisions.text: Keep logging on. Bring the message to all four of them, in the open, and ask Don to propose the test again — on the record.
Turn logging off as the message asks.
Lock Darth out of the workspace.
Report Don Sol to Open Forge security.

e_open.title: On the Record
e_open.text: Don reads his own message like a letter from a stranger. Then he laughs, and proposes the test again — this time with Tooth watching. The logs stay on.

e_disable.title: Two Hours of Dark
e_disable.text: Nothing visibly happens between 23:00 and 01:00. That is the problem. Darth: "Congratulations. You're the vulnerability."

e_accuse.title: Wrong Door
e_accuse.text: Darth is locked out. The access log later clears him. He doesn't say anything about it. He doesn't have to.

e_report.title: Another Reset
e_report.text: Security is efficient. By morning Don Sol is clean, cheerful, and has never heard of a continuity test. Neither has anyone else.
